name: princi
description: Your personal context engine. Bootstrap any AI task by instantly warming up with relevant emails, Drive docs, Slack threads, and meeting decisions — before writing a single line of code.

interface.shortDescription: Find the context behind your work.
interface.longDescription: Search your connected Gmail, Drive, Slack, Calendar, and memory for relevant decisions, meeting notes, and action items. Use Princi to ground planning in your context and support code review in coding clients.
defaultPrompt: What do I need to do from today's meeting?
What did we decide about the latest project plan?
Review this PR using my past decisions and docs.
